translatorNotes: Register: informal tú, consistent with Phase 1.

'intake' (client intake) -> 'admisión' throughout; native reviewer in Spain may prefer 'captación de clientes' for marketing SEO (used in secondary keywords). 'law firm' -> 'bufete' / 'despacho'; 'attorney' -> 'abogado'; 'matter' (legal matter) -> 'asunto'; 'retainer'/'retained' -> 'contrato'/'contratado' and 'hoja de encargo' for engagement letter.
'conflicts screening' -> 'revisión de conflictos'; 'fit' -> 'idoneidad'. 'court hours' -> 'horas de juzgado'; 'hearings' -> 'vistas'.
'privilege' (attorney-client) -> 'secreto profesional' (standard ES legal term). 'billable hours' -> 'horas facturables'.
'Clio' and 'practice management system' -> 'Clio' / 'sistema de gestión del despacho'. Brand names (Twilio, Calendly, n8n, Make) unchanged.
Prices/figures unchanged, currency named: '$1,000 and $5,000' -> '1.000 y 5.000 dólares'; '$50 to $300' -> '50 a 300 dólares'.
Compliance/ethics framing (confidentiality, no legal advice) is jurisdiction-sensitive; a reviewer should confirm wording fits the target market's bar rules — FLAG.
Blog 'related reading' links point to English blog posts (Phase 3 not started); anchor text translated. Nav/footer service + industry links point to /es.
